summary: Sony Group filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its Q2 FY2026 consolidated financial results presentation (three months ended September 30, 2026). Sales rose 10% to ¥3,429.4bn and operating income 45% to ¥622.3bn, with net income attributable to stockholders of ¥449.6bn (¥76.49 diluted per share). The filing notes the prior partial spin-off of Sony Financial Group (effective October 1, 2025), now reported as a discontinued operation, and includes an FY2026 forecast. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or deal terms are stated; this is an earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
